This month I'm working on several projects:

1. Broadcast (https://sendbroadcast.net) - Self hosted email marketing software. Been working on this since 2024 and positive revenue. Releasing v3 this week! :)

2. Render Screenshot (https://renderscreenshot.com) - Screenshot API (very much a scratch my own itch project)

3. Widgetful (https://widgetful.com) - A menubar app for managing multiple Claude Code agent sessions
